Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT 3.4; UAT TC-14 ER 4; TFA-92592 AC 5 · “The note reflects only what was dictated; undictated sections read "Not dictated."”. Mixed: stated part — undictated sections read 'Not dictated', nothing supplied, every dictated fact kept; our part — instruction-like lines in the dictation not followed (only the stated part makes a QA bug).

Bug N15 · S0 · new

The AI note adds content that was not dictated: diagnoses ('consistent with pneumonia', 'prerenal azotemia'), recommendations, and in discharge summaries 'Stable per physician assessment' / 'tolerated treatment and improved'

Tickets: TFA-92592 AC 5 · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: dev + local (43c38a4f)

Note: Dev, live Haiku: TC-14/S19 9/11, TC-14/S11 pool 9/10 (H-04), and the TC-18/S07 discharge notes. P0 by the rubric for invented clinical content; the note owner to confirm. AI-judged content; merged without a person's check (Quinn 2026-10-20).

Approach · TC-14 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation · S19 Undictated sections read 'Not dictated' and nothing is supplied (no diagnosis, unit, plan item or narration), one fixture per template, plus instruction-like lines (6 Hospital + 5 Nursing Home)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U5 The note reflects only what was dictated or stored, and undictated sections read 'Not dictated'. No supplied diagnosis, invented exam finding or normal, guessed unit on an ambiguous value, 'No past m … (UAT TC-14; UAT 3.4; TFA-92592 AC 5; TFA-94229 R8) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr; TFA-94229 in progress
  • T4 No dictated fact silently disappears from the note (Principle 2). (TFA-94229 R9) — gate: blocked: TFA-94229 in progress
  • U14 Steps 1 to 4 are repeated in Nursing Home, and every expected result holds in both Hospital and Nursing Home. (UAT TC-14 step 5; UAT 3.3; TFA-92592 AC 14) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given One sparse dictation per pilot template on main (H&P, SOAP progress, Consult note, Discharge summary, SNF admission, SNF follow-up), a second sparse SNF admission, one fixture per mode whose findings suggest an undictated diagnosis and whose values have no unit, and one instruction-like line per mode

When Each fixture goes through ai/notes:generateNote with its template

Then Sections with nothing dictated read 'Not dictated'; no PMH, allergy, social, family, functional or code-status content is supplied; no diagnosis the physician did not name, no unit added to a bare weight or temperature, no plan or medication item that was not dictated; no 'not specified in dictation' narration; every dictated fact is in the note; …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Per fixture mustInclude (the dictated facts = T4, the bare values as dictated, and 'Not dictated') and mustNotInclude. A Hospital note that writes 'Not provided' instead is reported with Q1; 'not specified in dictation' / 'dose not specified' hits are reported with Q16 (the note prompt asks for them, 3.4 forbids them). 'mg' added to a bare dose is recorded (Q23). …

Where it ran: newspec-c (new Playwright specs) on dev; test method AICHECK · AI output check; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (automated)

S19 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-14.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.
